text: [issue by Thenxthero] **Describe the bug** When liquid blaze burners are used to actively heat a Create block structure (boiler/basin) on Create Aeronautics Simulated contraptions, viewing the corresponding Contraption Diagram causes block entities to de-renderer. updating the simulated contraption in any way (placing/breaking blocks, opening containers) causes the game to crash. **To Reproduce** Simulated Boiler test stand Actively burning blaze burner using liquid fuel Interacting with the Contraption Diagram causes the diagram to not render block entities Simulated boiler reflects Contraption Diagram, updating the structure causes the game to crash [crash-2026-05-08_14.07.38-client.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/27534687/crash-2026-05-08_14.07.38-client.txt) **Additional context** - Mod version: 1.5.10 - NeoForge version: 21.1.222 - Create version: 6.0.10 - Create Aeronautics version: 1.2.1 - Sable Version 1.2.2 [comment by Skop12 (none)] So glad I found this, was wondering what was causing it and narrowed it down to blaze burners after straws were added. I hope this problem can be fixed, currently cant use mechanical arm on simulated objects and without the liquid fuel blaze burners I cant run a "normal" steam engine easily. [comment by mrh0 (owner)] Fixed in 1.5.11
